items.question: Which old free-text spellings besides the enum names are accepted when reading?
items.ticket: Existing values are normalised when read
items.chose: Maps only the cleaned form "in review" to review, and every other non-enum value reads as null.
items.instead: Accept a broader alias list (e.g. "in_progress", "submitted", "done"), or fuzzy-match to the nearest status.

items.question: How are case and separator variants of a stored value normalised?
items.ticket: Existing values are normalised when read
items.chose: Lowercases, collapses runs of whitespace, "-" and "_" into one space, and trims. Leading and trailing dashes or underscores also become spaces and are trimmed.
items.instead: Only trim and lowercase, or strip separators entirely so "in-review" becomes "inreview".

items.question: What does reading an unrecognised, empty or whitespace-only stored value return?
items.chose: Returns null instead of throwing or defaulting to a status such as draft.
items.instead: Throw an error, or fall back to a default status such as "draft".

items.question: Does writing a status normalise the input, or accept only exact enum values?
items.chose: Accepts only exact lowercase enum strings. "Draft", " review" and the old spelling "in-review" all throw.
items.instead: Normalise through readStatus first and write the canonical value, accepting "Draft" or "in-review".

items.question: How does writing an invalid status fail?
items.chose: Throws a generic Error whose message quotes the value as given.
items.instead: Return null or a result object, or throw a custom or typed error.

items.question: How does the bulk read treat rows whose status cannot be read?
items.chose: Keeps every row in the original order with status null and does not drop or throw.
items.instead: Drop unreadable rows from the result, or throw on the first unreadable row.

items.question: How are unreadable values reported in the bulk read, in terms of duplicates, ordering and form?
items.chose: Lists distinct raw stored values, as stored and not cleaned, once each, sorted by default string order.
items.instead: List the cleaned values, keep duplicates, report row ids, or keep first-seen order.

items.question: What does the bulk read return for an empty list of rows?
items.chose: Returns empty rows and an empty unreadable list.
items.instead: Throw, or return null or undefined.

items.question: Are inherited object keys such as "constructor" or "__proto__" treated as statuses?
items.chose: Looks values up in a Set and a Map, so such keys read as null.
items.instead: Use a plain object lookup, which would wrongly match inherited keys.
